body: Hexahedral FEA in scikit-fem showed the hand calculations were ~4.5× optimistic; a back rib plus front lip cut ledge deflection 1.55→0.34 mm and raised ultimate load 19→54 N.
S1–S5 family extracted; stop margins calibrated per ring ([0, 2, 4, 8] mm ladder); whole-family peaks 0.24–0.42 mm.

lead: Arch stops promoted to the model.
body: Two devices diverged on the same URL — a legal sliding mode, not a bug. Dual-end slot clamping + fixed-step integration; 168 tests green.
Next.js scaffold, content pool with build-time validation, four routes; LinkageFigure live on the homepage with SSR first frame.
Independent 3D kernel; three-tendon 120° tentacle; orbit camera. First version vetoed on feel — fascia anti-twist bracing brought lateral drift 38.5→1.2 px.
The physical S4 ring (angulated scissor arch + crank-slider) as a solver preset — kernel untouched, 7 new tests.
Release damping, live coupler tracing, engineering captions; 36 tests. Sealed: bugfixes only from here.
All five rings on one shaft: NEMA17 + TMC2209 through a 3:1 GT2 belt, and the shaft dropped 8→6 mm with filleted D-bore hubs. Peak design torque 0.3–0.5 N·m, gravity and friction dominant.
~¥216 of essentials plus condition-triggered items, ~¥300 with the conditionals. Existing kit stock explicitly excluded to avoid duplicate buys.
Line-length law, Tufte margin notes, Swiss grid — desktop-first case-study grid decided.
Math derivations, API, tolerances, milestones — the single source of truth for the solver line.

Death timing bounded to a ±30 s window with an honest debrief; the arithmetically infeasible HRV contrast dropped in favor of event-locked SCR. Six input channels, a nine-class event vocabulary and the grasp state machine frozen.
Two softbox kits and a sheet of white cardstock bent into an infinity curve. On a tripod brightness is a free variable; white-on-white parts stay legible only under low rear rim light.

The SG90 21T spline kept as the interface with M2 screws for custom linkages; FDM holes print 0.1–0.3 mm undersize, so model oversized. MPR121: one conductor is one measurement, so left/right discrimination costs two channels per feeler.

Null-space analysis: the bare arch has M0 = 2, so one rod under-constrains it — an apex vertical guide is what buys F = 1. Per-ring parameters optimized for 3–26% range gains; ring geometry, congruence classes and foot slots frozen.

HRI methodology — physiological sensing, validated scales, behavioral coding — is what separates this from aesthetic “robot death” work, and the behavior engine is the highest-leverage gap. Paper target: an HRI/CHI Late-Breaking Work.
Three 0.51 N·m steppers on TMC2209s (A4988/DRV8825 lack the current headroom), GT2 aluminum pulleys with custom D-bore, 12 V 5 A supply.

lead: Clearance rules for printed moving parts.
body: A print-in-place joint seized at 0.4 mm — SLS needs 0.5–0.6 mm for sintered skin and trapped powder. Switched to a metal axle in a printed sleeve (0.2–0.4 mm); axial clamping turned out to be the more fatal failure mode.
The ⌀10×4 mm disc scissor joint built around a shoulder screw — the smooth shoulder is journal and gap-setter at once, anchored in the bottom disc by a heat-set brass insert.

Three fully actuated tentacles became one tendon-driven arm plus two compliant feelers — one expressive limb, two reflexive ones. Clarified in the same pass: this is not biomimicry, the mechanical look is deliberate so that behavior stays the independent variable.

Dumbbell slide-in pins (⌀3×15 mm) with the keyway perpendicular to tendon pull — no press-fit stress, fully disassemblable. Tendons: 0.4–0.5 mm braided PE in 1.0–1.2 mm channels, knotted into anchor cavities.
Five directions weighed — variable-length scissors, angulated units, You–Pellegrino bars, Bennett rings, phased kinetic walls. Angulated scissors won on parametric and simulation compatibility.

Rigid bodies, two-point hinges and multi-segment spring tendons in Kangaroo2; strength hierarchy fixed at anchor 10000 > body 1000 > collide 100 > spring 1–3. Four tapered segments and three tendons — and the friction-driven sequential propagation reads as lifelike rather than as a defect.
A full physics definition parsed component by component — spring, anchor, grab, bouncy solver — and the constraint-and-solver logic internalized. Everything downstream leans on this.

lead: Physical form framework and study protocol v1.
body: Four components — bell jar, appendages, eye stalk, base — plus a 13-item function hierarchy and two interaction channels. Protocol: 5–8 participants, 4 accelerated life cycles, ~37-minute sessions, IDAQ / IRI / ECR-S / Godspeed and physiological signals.

Under what conditions do people form pet-like attachment to a non-living thing, and how does it surface at loss. An early drift toward maximizing grief was corrected — death and rebirth are the instrument, not the goal.
Three concepts drafted out of the “cyber soul-calling” wave that followed the GPT-4o update — Reincarnation Machine, Presence, Unconscious Nudge. The first one stuck.
